Loss report: drone -> tekton
[external] pipeline/drone/trigger/0 trigger.push: Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/ci/step/build script.interpolation: shell variable (a secret or variable in the script is read as a shell variable from the step env)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/ci/step/source-checkout step.action: StepAction ref to the tektoncd-catalog git-clone through the git resolver (the ctx-repo and ctx-sha params carry the repository and the commit)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/ref/secrets.TOKEN config.name: secrets through secretKeyRef on Secret ci-secrets, vars through configMapKeyRef on ConfigMap ci-vars (the Secret values and ConfigMap values are not written)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/ref/vars.REGION config.name: secrets through secretKeyRef on Secret ci-secrets, vars through configMapKeyRef on ConfigMap ci-vars (the Secret values and ConfigMap values are not written)
